title: Context-Dependent Effects of Apolipoprotein A2 on Lipid Metabolism and Atherogenesis.
abstract: Apolipoprotein A2 (APOA2) is a component of several plasma lipoproteins, yet its physiological and pathological functions remain unclear. Conflicting data regarding its effects on plasma lipid levels and cardiovascular risk indicate that APOA2 activity may be context dependent.
